name: TZ THT-02 Industrial RS-485 Temperature & Humidity Sensor
manual_title: TZ THT-02 Temperature and humidity Sensor User's Manual V1.1

zones.label: Stainless Steel Slotted Strainer & SHT30/SHT3X Probe Head
zones.label_en: Stainless Steel Slotted Strainer & SHT30/SHT3X Probe Head
probable_faults: Ventilation slot obstruction from industrial dust, oil mist, or lint buildup
Liquid condensation or chemical vapor contamination on the SHT30/SHT3X CMOSens element
Mechanical fracture of the protective slotted cap from direct physical impact
probable_faults_en: Ventilation slot obstruction from industrial dust, oil mist, or lint buildup
Liquid condensation or chemical vapor contamination on the SHT30/SHT3X CMOSens element
Mechanical fracture of the protective slotted cap from direct physical impact
electrical_symptoms: Holding registers 0x0000 (Temp) and/or 0x0001 (RH) return sentinel value 7FFF H (32767 = sensor is abnormal)
Degraded hygrometric step response time (>> 8s in flowing air)
Persistent calibration drift beyond rated accuracy (> ±2%RH or > ±0.3°C)
recommended_actions: De-energize the DC 5~24V supply rail and purge strainer slots with clean, dry low-pressure air (< 1 bar)
Inspect the internal SHT30/SHT3X element without mechanical contact; dry in a desiccant chamber if condensation occurred
If register 0x0000 or 0x0001 remains locked at 7FFF H after drying, replace the sensor probe module
recommended_actions_en: De-energize the DC 5~24V supply rail and purge strainer slots with clean, dry low-pressure air (< 1 bar)
Inspect the internal SHT30/SHT3X element without mechanical contact; dry in a desiccant chamber if condensation occurred
If register 0x0000 or 0x0001 remains locked at 7FFF H after drying, replace the sensor probe module

zones.label: Upper Quality Probe Elastomeric Seal Ring
zones.label_en: Upper Quality Probe Elastomeric Seal Ring
probable_faults: Elastomeric O-ring dried out or cracked from thermal cycling (> 85°C) or chemical exposure
Seal ring displaced from its perimeter groove or pinched during barrel reassembly
probable_faults_en: Elastomeric O-ring dried out or cracked from thermal cycling (> 85°C) or chemical exposure
Seal ring displaced from its perimeter groove or pinched during barrel reassembly
electrical_symptoms: Progressive moisture ingress migrating from the sampling head into the internal DIP-8 PCB chamber
Intermittent erratic readings or sporadic 7FFF H spikes in high-humidity environments (> 85%RH)
recommended_actions: Verify uniform seating of the black elastomeric O-ring around the full 16.0 mm barrel perimeter
Replace any worn NBR/Viton seal ring and confirm non-condensing operation within -40~85°C
recommended_actions_en: Verify uniform seating of the black elastomeric O-ring around the full 16.0 mm barrel perimeter
Replace any worn NBR/Viton seal ring and confirm non-condensing operation within -40~85°C

zones.label: Upper Housing Barrel & Internal 8-Position DIP Switch PCB
zones.label_en: Upper Housing Barrel & Internal 8-Position DIP Switch PCB
probable_faults: Reversed binary DIP-8 bit weights (Pin 1 is MSB=128 and Pin 8 is LSB=1)
DIP rockers left half-seated, oxidized, or all set to OFF (invalid Modbus Slave Address 0)
Unscrewed upper housing barrel or longitudinal hairline crack in polymer shell
probable_faults_en: Reversed binary DIP-8 bit weights (Pin 1 is MSB=128 and Pin 8 is LSB=1)
DIP rockers left half-seated, oxidized, or all set to OFF (invalid Modbus Slave Address 0)
Unscrewed upper housing barrel or longitudinal hairline crack in polymer shell
electrical_symptoms: Complete Modbus-RTU poll timeout when the host queries an address different from the hardware DIP-8 setting
RS-485 bus frame collisions caused by two sensors sharing the same Address Code (register 0x0004)
Unexpected slave ID in register 0x0004 (e.g., Pins 1, 3, 4 ON = 128 + 32 + 16 = 176 / 0xB0)
recommended_actions: Perform the mandatory 2-Step opening procedure (Step 1: loosen rear waterproof nut; Step 2: unscrew middle barrel)
Seat all 8 DIP rockers firmly per binary weights [128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1] and verify register 0x0004 via Function 0x03
recommended_actions_en: Perform the mandatory 2-Step opening procedure (Step 1: loosen rear waterproof nut; Step 2: unscrew middle barrel)
Seat all 8 DIP rockers firmly per binary weights [128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1] and verify register 0x0004 via Function 0x03

zones.label: Snap-On Mounting Flange Ears & Mid-Body Thread Seam
zones.label_en: Snap-On Mounting Flange Ears & Mid-Body Thread Seam
probable_faults: Fractured mounting ear (4.2 mm holes on 32.0 mm centers) due to over-torqued fasteners or duct vibration
Partially unthreaded middle barrel seam after DIP-8 adjustment, exposing the central O-ring seal
probable_faults_en: Fractured mounting ear (4.2 mm holes on 32.0 mm centers) due to over-torqued fasteners or duct vibration
Partially unthreaded middle barrel seam after DIP-8 adjustment, exposing the central O-ring seal
electrical_symptoms: Vibration-induced micro-interruptions causing inter-byte gaps > 1.5 characters (silent RTU frame discard)
Loss of IP65 environmental sealing at the mid-seam, risking trace oxidation on the RS-485 bus
recommended_actions: Replace any cracked 42.0 mm snap-on mounting bracket and fasten with M4 screws without ovalizing the 16.0 mm barrel
Ensure full thread engagement at the central barrel seam before tightening the rear compression gland nut
recommended_actions_en: Replace any cracked 42.0 mm snap-on mounting bracket and fasten with M4 screws without ovalizing the 16.0 mm barrel
Ensure full thread engagement at the central barrel seam before tightening the rear compression gland nut

zones.label: Lower Barrel Housing: RS-485 Transceiver & 5-24V DC Regulator
zones.label_en: Lower Barrel Housing: RS-485 Transceiver & 5-24V DC Regulator
probable_faults: Excessive RS-485 common-mode voltage from missing equipotential ground reference between sensors and transverter
Thermal stress on the DC regulator or RS-485 transceiver due to > 24V DC overvoltage or reverse polarity
Baud rate mismatch in register 0x0005 relative to the SCADA master (4800 / 9600 / 19200 bps)
probable_faults_en: Excessive RS-485 common-mode voltage from missing equipotential ground reference between sensors and transverter
Thermal stress on the DC regulator or RS-485 transceiver due to > 24V DC overvoltage or reverse polarity
Baud rate mismatch in register 0x0005 relative to the SCADA master (4800 / 9600 / 19200 bps)
electrical_symptoms: Supply current deviating from nominal 5 mA (0 mA open circuit or > 30 mA shorted transceiver)
Continuous CRC-16 checksum errors (polynomial 0xA001) or differential A+/B- bus latch-up
Modbus exception responses 0x83 / 0x86 with error codes 01, 02, or 03
recommended_actions: Verify stable DC 5~24V supply across Red (V+) and Black (GND) with nominal ~5 mA current draw
Bond all Black (GND) leads and cable shields to the RS-232/RS-485 transverter Gnd terminal to suppress common-mode voltage
Confirm matching serial parameters (4800/9600/19200 bps, 8N1) or update register 0x0005 via Function 0x06
recommended_actions_en: Verify stable DC 5~24V supply across Red (V+) and Black (GND) with nominal ~5 mA current draw
Bond all Black (GND) leads and cable shields to the RS-232/RS-485 transverter Gnd terminal to suppress common-mode voltage
Confirm matching serial parameters (4800/9600/19200 bps, 8N1) or update register 0x0005 via Function 0x06

zones.label: Waterproof Compression Terminal Gland & 1m 4-Wire Shielded Lead
zones.label_en: Waterproof Compression Terminal Gland & 1m 4-Wire Shielded Lead
probable_faults: Twisted or severed internal conductors caused by unscrewing the barrel without loosening the rear gland nut first (First Step violation)
Swapped RS-485 differential pair Yellow (A+) and Green (B-), or ungrounded shield drain
Loose tapered compression nut allowing axial strain directly onto internal PCB solder pads
probable_faults_en: Twisted or severed internal conductors caused by unscrewing the barrel without loosening the rear gland nut first (First Step violation)
Swapped RS-485 differential pair Yellow (A+) and Green (B-), or ungrounded shield drain
Loose tapered compression nut allowing axial strain directly onto internal PCB solder pads
electrical_symptoms: Complete absence of RS-485 replies due to inverted A+/B- polarity or broken conductor
Intermittent power brownouts when flexing the 1-meter lead jacket
Elevated packet loss from EMI pickup on long industrial bus runs (up to 1200 m)
recommended_actions: Verify the 4-wire color code: Red = V+ (DC 5~24V), Black = GND, Yellow = RS-485 A+, Green = RS-485 B-
Check end-to-end conductor continuity, ground the cable shield at the converter end, and torque the ribbed waterproof gland nut
recommended_actions_en: Verify the 4-wire color code: Red = V+ (DC 5~24V), Black = GND, Yellow = RS-485 A+, Green = RS-485 B-
Check end-to-end conductor continuity, ground the cable shield at the converter end, and torque the ribbed waterproof gland nut

leads.name: Black GND
leads.label: GND
leads.function: Public ground (DC negative terminal & RS-485 common-mode reference)

leads.name: Yellow A+
leads.label: A+
leads.function: RS485 interface A+ (non-inverting differential data line)

leads.name: Green B-
leads.label: B-
leads.function: RS485 interface B- (inverting differential data line)

opening_procedure: First Step: Unscrew the rear waterproof terminal nut so the lead cable rotates freely without twisting.
Second Step: Unscrew the housing barrel at the middle seam to expose the internal 8-position DIP switch PCB.
opening_procedure_en: First Step: Unscrew the rear waterproof terminal nut so the lead cable rotates freely without twisting.
Second Step: Unscrew the housing barrel at the middle seam to expose the internal 8-position DIP switch PCB.

function_codes.0x06: Write single holding register (0x0005 baud rate)

crc16.byte_order: little-endian (CRC low byte first, CRC high byte second)

Humidity (SHT3X): 5~95%RH, res 0.1%RH, ±2%RH, ~8s response, <±0.25%RH/yr drift

manual_pages.title: Environmental Conditions, 4-Lead Wiring & PC Bus Schematic
manual_pages.title_en: Environmental Conditions, 4-Lead Wiring & PC Bus Schematic

Leads: Green = B-, Yellow = A+, Black = GND, Red = V+
Common-mode voltage warning: tie sensor GND and cable shield to RS-232/RS-485 transverter ground

manual_pages.title: 8-Bit DIP Switch Address Code, 2-Step Opening & Data Frame Format
manual_pages.title_en: 8-Bit DIP Switch Address Code, 2-Step Opening & Data Frame Format
highlights: First Step: unscrew waterproof terminal nut; Second Step: unscrew barrel to access DIP switch
Default serial frame: 1 start bit, 8 data bits, 0 parity, 1 stop bit (8N1)

manual_pages.title: RTU Frame Timing & Holding Register Map
manual_pages.title_en: RTU Frame Timing & Holding Register Map
highlights: >=3.5 char frame boundary; >1.5 char inter-byte gap causes silent drop
0x0000 Temp (0.1°C) & 0x0001 RH (0.1%RH) — 7FFF H means sensor is abnormal
0x0004 DIP Address (R), 0x0005 Baud Rate 4800/9600/19200 (R/W), 0x0006 HW ver, 0x0007 SW ver

manual_pages.title: Modbus Poll Example & Function Code 03 Read Request/Response
manual_pages.title_en: Modbus Poll Example & Function Code 03 Read Request/Response
highlights: Function 0x03 host request: 01 03 00 00 00 08 44 0C
21-byte response frame layout for registers 0x0000..0x0007

manual_pages.title: Data Decoding Example, Function Code 06 Baud Write & Abnormal Response
manual_pages.title_en: Data Decoding Example, Function Code 06 Baud Write & Abnormal Response
highlights: Function 0x06 set 9600 bps: 01 06 00 05 25 80 82 FB
Abnormal response sets function code MSB to 1 (0x83 / 0x86)

manual_pages.title: Exception Error Codes, CRC-16 Algorithm & Mechanical Dimensions
manual_pages.title_en: Exception Error Codes, CRC-16 Algorithm & Mechanical Dimensions
highlights: Error codes: 01 Illegal function, 02 Illegal data address, 03 Illegal data value
CRC-16 init 0xFFFF, right-shift XOR polynomial 0xA001
